title: Change-Size Rule for Change Order Administration Fees — Ridgeline Installation Services
content:
The change order administration fee on a Ridgeline Installation Services contract is worked out from a scaled amount set by the size of the change. The scaled amount is rounded only where the rule below says so; the change order administration fee worked out from it is rounded to the cent only at the end, no amount on the way to it being rounded.

**Change-size rule.** When the change order's billed increase is above the large-change floor of 1500.00, the scaled amount is the program's change order administration fee plus the per-thousand charge of 10.00 for every full 1000.00 of the increase; when the increase is below the small-change ceiling of 250.00, the scaled amount is the program's change order administration fee multiplied by the small-change share of 0.5 and rounded to the cent; any other increase takes the program's change order administration fee as the scaled amount.

## Terms used

- **The change order's billed increase** is the amount of the most recent change order billing line on the contract, the price increase of that change order alone.
- **Every full 1000.00** counts whole thousands only: an increase of 3750.00 contains 3 full thousands.

| Billed increase of the change order | Scaled amount |
|---|---|
| above 1500.00 | the program's fee plus 10.00 for every full 1000.00 of the increase |
| 250.00 up to and including 1500.00 | the program's fee |
| below 250.00 | the program's fee multiplied by 0.5, rounded to the cent |

## Worked figures (hypothetical program change order administration fee 50.00)

| Billed increase | Full thousands | Scaled amount |
|---|---|---|
| 3750.00 | 3 | 80.00 |
| 2000.00 | 2 | 70.00 |
| 1999.99 | 1 | 60.00 |
| 1500.01 | 1 | 60.00 |
| 1500.00 | not above the floor | 50.00 |
| 250.00 | not below the ceiling | 50.00 |
| 249.99 | below the ceiling | 25.00 |

With a hypothetical program fee of 25.00, an increase of 180.00 gives a scaled amount of 12.50.
